messages.subject: Error after -Minimize: Conditions 'urbd' do not match the set names from "snames" argument.
parts:
There is an error that keeps popping up after I run "minimize" following the examples in the most recent manual (p.27).  Please advise. Thank you very much.


The example command are below  (p.27 of the QCA3.7 Manual): 

# -----
# Lipset binary crisp data
# the associated truth table
ttLC <- truthTable(LC, "SURV", sort.by = "incl, n", show.cases = TRUE) ttLC
# conservative solution (Rihoux & De Meur 2009, p.57)
cLC <- minimize(ttLC)

Then the error shows: 
Error: Conditions 'urbd' do not match the set names from "snames" argument.
In addition: Warning message:
In if (all(target == toupper(target)) & expression != toupper(expression) &  :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used


I am using the package "QCA3.6" with R.  My R version is 3.6.2. Mac OS 10.15.3.

https://artifacts.r-hub.io/QCA_3.7.tar.gz-9c805f4def7f47688b5503711f3149e7/

parts:
If you've already installed Xcode, then open up a terminal and type this:
xcode-select --install

This will install the command line tools that are needed to compile the package from the sources. Once these are installed, simply type (again in the Terminal):
R CMD INSTALL /path/to/QCA_3.7.tar.gz

Hopefully this will work, although I am not sure because I am experimenting with some flags needed for parallel computing using OpenMP.
But why not simply dowloading the binary from rhub, since it is already built?

Hope this helps,
Adrian
